preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 5000, inclusive.
The index of the capital is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 0 if all cities are already reachable from the capital, or a positive integer representing the minimum number of new roads needed to make all cities reachable from the capital.
